name: Gaussian Splitting and Pruning
definition: A deterministic approach to modify the number of Gaussians in a reconstruction by splitting Gaussians with high reconstruction responsibility and removing those with minimal contribution, based on statistical criteria.
summary: Gaussian Splitting and Pruning is a deterministic density control method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses statistical analysis of per-ray losses and weights to decide splitting and pruning, unlike the heuristic gradient-based densification of the base method.
